name: ScrollArea
description: A scrolling box with thin overlay scrollbars that look the same on every platform and theme. Scrolling itself stays native (wheel, touch, keyboard); the scrollbars can also be dragged, and a press on the rail pages. The element is the scroll container, so `ref` and `onScroll` work on it directly; `actionsRef` adds `scrollToElement`.

props.name: actionsRef
props.type: ((instance: ScrollAreaActions | null) => void | (() => void | { [UNDEFINED_VOID_ONLY]: never; }) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<ScrollAreaActions | null>
props.description: Methods to scroll from code that the scroll element doesn't have natively.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Class of the element that wraps `children`. Put padding here, not on the scroll area.

props.name: contentStyle
props.description: Style of the element that wraps `children`.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the content out toward an edge that has more past it. The scrollbars don't fade.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: How long the scrollbars stay after scrolling stops, in ms. At least 100 with `trigger="scroll"`.

props.name: onEdgeChange
props.description: Called when the area reaches or leaves an edge, and after mounting when the content overflows.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The directions the area scrolls in. Content too wide for a vertical area is cut off.

props.name: overscroll
props.description: What a scroll that reaches the end does: stop there with no bounce (`none`, the default), stop there but let Mac trackpads and iOS bounce the area (`contain`), or carry on to the page behind (`auto`). Only in the directions the area overflows right now.

props.name: railInset
props.description: Room in px the scrollbars keep clear at each end, such as a sticky header's height, so they don't run over it. Also settable in CSS, on the area itself: `--r-scroll-area-rail-inset-{top,bottom,left,right}`, which don't inherit.

props.name: size
props.description: Thumb thickness: `small` is 5px, `medium` 7px; both grow while pointed at or dragged.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the scrollbars show. They always show while scrolling or dragging.

name: ScrollAreaTextarea
description: A native `<textarea>` with ScrollArea's overlay scrollbar. The textarea scrolls itself (it can't hold the rails), so a wrapper holds both and the rails lie over the textarea's box (`useScrollAreaRails` with a wrapper). Its own `scrollHeight` is the content size: it is measured on every input and render, and when the box resizes. Native props, `ref` and `onScroll` go to the textarea.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: How long the scrollbar stays after scrolling stops, as on ScrollArea.

props.name: overscroll
props.description: Whether a scroll that reaches the end carries on to the page, as on ScrollArea.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When the scrollbar shows, as on ScrollArea.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class of the wrapper that holds the textarea and its scrollbar.

props.name: wrapperStyle
props.description: Style of the wrapper; size the textarea itself with `className` / `style`.
